title: Verify the fee/discount template library is at Administration → Finance → Fees & Discounts (below Payment Methods)
custom_steps:
1. Open Administration (the gear/admin area).
  2. In the left menu, look under the 'FINANCE' heading.
  3. Click 'Fees & Discounts'.
custom_expected:
1. A 'Fees & Discounts' page opens.
  2. In the left menu it sits under 'FINANCE', directly below 'Payment Methods'.
